Five different drivers won at least one race in 2017.

The 2017 final standings [6] list the win totals: Lewis Hamilton (9), Sebastian Vettel (5), Valtteri Bottas (3), Max Verstappen (2) and Daniel Ricciardo (1). The totals sum to 20 wins, and the constructor figures agree (Mercedes 12, Ferrari 5, Red Bull 3). The race reports in [1], [2], [3], [4] and [8] are consistent with this: Hamilton won Japan, Canada and the United States, Vettel won Monaco, and Bottas won Russia.

ANSWER: 5
